sentence: This project develops radiolabeled agents that image cancer and treat it, and refines radiolabeling protocols.
This project studies whether the genetic data of healthy babies should be kept on file for lifetime care, and asks what parents prefer.
This project tests whether adding radiation to a T cell therapy that targets an oncogene works better against glioblastoma.
This project studies how input from the lateral habenula to the rostromedial tegmental nucleus shapes withdrawal symptoms from alcohol.
This project tries to find which genes control tumor growth and resistance to immunity in four cancers, using genomic data and computational analysis.
This project studies how chromosome regulation in early animal development activates some genes and represses others to make embryonic stem cells.
This project develops natural language processing models that learn from electronic health record data to help clinicians reach accurate diagnoses.
This project tests whether the amyloid antibody donanemab is safe and works for people with Dementia with Lewy bodies and Alzheimer’s disease.
This project studies how a chemical change to proteins called glycosylation contributes to Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias.
This project studies how reversible lipid modifications control enzymes like calcineurin to keep calcium signaling precise at membranes.
This project studies how a Major Histocompatibility Class II-like molecule negatively regulates antigen presentation, which bears on vaccination.
This project builds deep learning methods that read radiology and pathology images to help guide treatment for patients with gastric cancer.
This project studies what controls how the body takes up and regulates vitamin A.
This project studies how HIV in the brain and brain inflammation affect neurocognitive impairment in older people living with HIV.
This project studies how the mosquito Aedes aegypti senses light and uses visual cues to find people.
This project tests a smartphone application that aims to help Black adults with HIV/AIDS who smoke quit smoking and improve mental well-being.
This project runs two pilot projects that look at how genes relate to drinking behaviors and cardiovascular disease.
This project uses a systems biological approach to study why a malaria vaccine gives only partial, fading protection in young children.
This project builds molecular imaging platforms that combine several imaging methods, with AI-based image analysis, to help discover and understand cancer.
This project studies how the makeup and layout of the head and neck cancer tumor immune microenvironment affect response to immunotherapy over time.
